societies.overview: The Australian National University International Law Society ('ANU ILS') is the university's second-largest law students' society and its only community for those passionate about international law. With more than a decade of experience, we organise an exciting range of academic, career and social events, programs and resources for domestic and international undergraduate and postgraduate students passionate about international law. events.title: Lyrical Foundations Course
events.location: Studio 1, ANU Sport, The Australian National University, North Road, Acton ACT, Australia
events.description: Come join us for a 3-week foundations course in Lyrical style! Are you new to dancing, wanting to try a new style or just wanting to brush up and feel more confident? Grow your confidence as you get the time to work with a teacher over 3 weeks to build skill, learn to pick up choreography, meet other dance enthusiasts and have lots of fun in a safe environment!! This course focuses lyrical/ contemporary styles. An expressive dance form that often focuses on storytelling and draws heavily from jazz and ballet in many aspects. All are welcome from absolute beginners

events.title: Latin America Week @ ANU! 🌎✨
events.location: The Australian National University, Canberra ACT, Australia
events.description: Latin America Week is Back! 🌎 ✨ Get ready for a week packed with the best of Latin America right here at ANU! From Monday 28 September – Sunday 4 October , we're taking over campus with daily events celebrating everything that makes Latin America so vibrant. From food, music and dance to language, culture, history and community. Here's the lineup: 📅 Mon 28 Sept, 7pm , Latin America Trivia 🎶 Tue 29 Sept, 7pm , Bossa Nova Night with Jazz Soc 💃 Wed 30 Sept, 7pm , Free Brazilian Funk Class 🍨 Thu 1 Oct, 6:45pm , Messina Run

events.title: FrogWatch Census Training
events.location: Hancock Library, Acton Campus, Sullivans Creek Road, Acton ACT, Australia
events.description: Spring is here, which means FrogTober is just around the corner! This time, ANU Intrepid Landcare will be joining the Ginninderra Catchment Group for one of their annual FrogWatch Census Training sessions. The training will prepare us to take part in the ACT and region FrogCensus, where citizen scientists head out to local waterways and wetlands to record frog calls and help collect valuable data about local frog populations. events.title: Coffee and Chat with Dr Janet Bultitude
events.location: Rex Espresso, University Avenue, Acton ACT, Australia
events.description: Come grab a coffee/treat, say hi, and meet our special guest, Dr Janet Bultitude. Dr Janet Bultitude is a Senior Lecturer in Psychology and Evaluation at ANU, with over 20 years of experience researching how the brain, body, and environment influence perception and pain. Her work spans psychology, neuroscience, and medicine, with a particular focus on chronic pain, rehabilitation, and applying research to improve health outcomes. Come along for a coffee, a chat, and the chance to learn more about the brain and pain.

events.title: IBF Cuppa & Catchup

events.description: We've been reading Mark's Gospel and hear about Jesus in the Bible on Fridays at IBF. Dom and Aggie would love to meet any students over at The Street Cafe this Wednesday 30/9 between 12pm to 2pm. Just sit down, enjoy a cuppa or any beverage of your choice (it will be our shout), chatting about faith in Jesus, what really matters, who Jesus is to you.... We look forward to hearing from you!

events.title: McGrathNicol Interview Workshop
events.location: 60 Marcus Clarke Street, Canberra ACT, Australia
events.description: Get interview-ready with McGrathNicol and AFEC 💼✨ Join us for an Interview Workshop at McGrathNicol's Canberra office, where you'll gain practical insights into what employers look for, how to approach common interview questions, and how to present yourself with confidence throughout the recruitment process. Whether you're applying for internships, graduate roles, or simply want to sharpen your interview skills, this is a great opportunity to hear directly from industry professionals and ask your questions.
